title: AI Act Scientific Panel
summary: The AI Act Scientific Panel is a group of experts tasked with reviewing and advising on the scientific and technical aspects of the AI Act. They assess AI risks, propose evidence‑based measures, and provide recommendations to lawmakers to ensure the legislation is grounded in scientific understanding.

title: Draft Standardisation Request
summary: The document presents a draft request for standardization, proposing guidelines or criteria to unify AI practices across different entities. It likely aims to establish consistent, transparent, and accountable AI policies that can be adopted broadly.

summary: The notice announces a public consultation on a new Code of Practice (CoP) related to AI. It invites stakeholders to give feedback and explains how the consultation process will be carried out.

summary: This document announces a call for participants to express interest in joining a Community of Practice (CoP) dedicated to AI policy. It outlines how to submit an expression of interest and describes the CoP’s goals, membership criteria, and expected contributions.

title: CoP Graphic: Overview of Iterative Drafting Process
summary: The document presents a graphic that outlines the iterative drafting process used by a community of practice, showing each step from initial drafting to final approval. It highlights how drafts are repeatedly reviewed, revised, and refined through stakeholder feedback to achieve a well‑polished final product.

title: CoP Graphic: Timeline of Drafting Process
summary: This document provides a visual timeline that outlines the major stages of drafting the Community of Practice (CoP) policy. It shows when each phase started, its duration, and the key decisions taken during the drafting process.

title: Code of Practice: 1st Draft
summary: This document presents a preliminary set of guidelines for the responsible development and use of AI systems. It outlines key principles, risk‑management steps, and best practices to promote transparency, safety, and ethical deployment of AI technology.

title: Code of Practice: 2nd Draft
summary: This document presents the second draft of a Code of Practice for AI, outlining guidelines for responsible design, use, and oversight of artificial intelligence systems. It emphasizes transparency, safety, and accountability, aiming to ensure AI technologies are developed and deployed ethically and in line with applicable regulations.

title: Code of Practice: 3rd Draft
summary: The document presents the third draft of a Code of Practice, offering updated guidance and best practices for stakeholders. It sets clear expectations for compliance, safety, and ethical conduct in technology development and deployment.

title: AI Pact Draft
summary: The AI Pact Draft proposes a set of principles and guidelines for responsible AI development and deployment, focusing on transparency, safety, and fairness. It calls for international cooperation and the creation of regulatory frameworks to address the challenges posed by advanced artificial intelligence technologies.

title: AI Pact Final
summary: The AI Pact Final is a global agreement that sets out shared rules and best practices for developing, using, and regulating artificial intelligence. It focuses on ensuring AI is safe, transparent, and fair, while encouraging cooperation among governments, companies, and researchers to share benefits and reduce risks.

title: Guidelines on prohibited artificial intelligence (AI) practices
summary: This policy lists the AI activities that are disallowed, such as using AI for deception, discrimination, or unsafe decision‑making. It also explains how to avoid these prohibited practices and outlines the consequences for violating the rules.

title: Guidelines on AI System Definition
summary: This policy gives clear rules for what counts as an AI system, helping organizations recognize and label the technologies they use. It outlines specific criteria and boundaries that determine how AI tools are classified, governed, and monitored.

title: Communication on Boosting Start-Ups & Innovation
summary: The document outlines strategies for communicating to support start‑up growth and foster innovation within the community. It highlights key messages, outreach methods, and stakeholder engagement to create an ecosystem that encourages new businesses and creative solutions.

title: EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups
summary: The EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups is a European program that gives early‑stage tech companies access to high‑performance computing resources and expertise, helping them build and test AI and other compute‑heavy projects. It provides funding, training, and supercomputing facilities to accelerate innovation and bring new technologies to market.

title: Slideshow: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: This webinar provides an overview of risk management principles, explaining how organizations can identify, assess, and mitigate potential risks. It covers best practices and tools to implement effective risk strategies in business operations.

title: Video: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: The webinar covers how to spot, assess, and reduce risks that can arise when using AI. It also explains best practices for staying alert to new threats and quickly responding to problems.
